Maria: Quick sync — two-day post-go-live backlog jam. Need to split top 12 items into bug vs enhancement for next sprint. I propose: urgent bug bucket (sev A/B) -> patch; others -> scheduled. Thoughts?

Ajit: +1. Can we prioritize customer-facing regressions and anything causing incorrect outputs? Example: SaaSCo search rank change.

Dmitri: Agreed. Also call out embeddings latency regression (3.2s -> 4.8s) — that looks infra/quantization-related, push to P0 until repro'd.

Leah: From support: 6 customers hit the rank issue, 2 reported data loss. Data loss should be P0.

Maria: Okay — quick triage criteria proposal (if it helps triage fast):

```
PRIORITY CRITERIA (quick):
- Sev A (hotfix asap): data loss / crash OR incorrect results impacting >=2 customers OR security exposure
- Sev B (patch within sprint): perf regression >=30% affecting >=3 customers OR core feature degraded
- Enhancement: QoL, single-customer asks, UX polish, nice-to-have
- Operational wrinkle: if fix complexity is high, consider canary + rollback plan
```

Ajit: Add rollback risk and customer SLA exposure to the decision matrix. If rollback risk high, prefer canary + feature-flag patch.

Leah: Support will consolidate incidents into one aggregated Jira per customer and link here. That'll speed up triage.

Maria: Assignments (quick):
- SaaSCo rank regression -> Ajit
- Embeddings perf regression -> Dmitri
- Autocomplete UI polish -> James (low priority)

ops-bot: deploy-prod-6789 succeeded :white_check_mark:

James: Autocomplete is small; can slip to next minor release if the core fixes take priority. Happy to take when ready.

Dmitri: I'll start a perf repro now. If it's kernel/quantization, will loop in eng-runtime.

Ajit: If we need a hotfix canary, ping me and I'll set up burst capacity / routing override. /assign Ajit

Maria: Cool — I'll create the triage tickets, tag owners, and run a 90m check-in. If anyone adds a new incident, drop it into this thread. :rocket:
